pharmacology.text: JWH-015 is a chemical from the naphthoylindole family that acts as a subtype-selective cannabinoid agonist. Its affinity for CB2 receptors is 13.8 nM, while its affinity for CB1 is 383 nM, meaning that it binds almost 28 times more strongly to CB2 than to CB1. It has been shown to possess immunomodulatory effects, and CB2 agonists may be useful in the treatment of pain and inflammation.
